source_of_authorization: Parent explicitly fixed all four strict improvements before any source fit; source-only engineering release criterion.
selection: Checkpoint always lowest macro source unweighted valid-center query jointNLL; release rule never changes selected checkpoint or threshold.

decoder.joint: argmax among ordered VV,EV,EE,OV,OE,OO; first index wins ties
decoder.confidence: max joint probability>=.5 accepted else pairU
decoder.scale: exact for four comparative engineering criteria

E_precision.definition: Among all YCB exact queries predicted E by accepted jointMAP, fraction with exact GT E.
E_precision.required_comparison: strictly > frozen v64 baseline; compare exact integer ratios by cross multiplication

strict_E_recall_all_GT.definition: Among fixed YCB source evidence strict_external_corroborated_5x5=1 queries (176), fraction predicted exact E. All U and wrong classes count as misses.
strict_E_recall_all_GT.required_comparison: strictly > frozen v64 baseline; compare exact integer ratios by cross multiplication

O_recall_all_GT.definition: Among all YCB exact GT O queries, fraction predicted exact O. U counts as miss.
O_recall_all_GT.required_comparison: strictly > frozen v64 baseline; compare exact integer ratios by cross multiplication

overall_confidence_coverage.definition: All YCB queries with max six-joint probability>=.5 divided by all3200 YCB queries; U retained in denominator.
overall_confidence_coverage.required_comparison: strictly > frozen v64 baseline; compare exact integer ratios by cross multiplication

source_NLL_rule: For every evaluation source domain, query jointNLL strictly below empirical TRAIN-only prior NLL. If no training examples from that domain, use and disclose global TRAIN prior. Laplace1 additional diagnostic only.
decision: RELEASE only if all4ratioimprovements AND everydomainNLLbeatsTRAINprior; else HOLD. Missing/undefined metric or data-integrity failure =>HOLD.
scope_caution: Passing is a comparative engineering check against v64, not proof of solved external occlusion or private reliability. No retries, threshold fitting, new datasets or unbounded architecture search.
